description: What paid AI-agent tools cost and who sells the most, from an hourly index of Coinbase's x402 marketplace (about 32,000 pay-per-call endpoints). For a category or a search phrase: the typical price that paying wallets actually accept (median, middle range, top 10%), a price distribution, the top sellers by distinct paying wallets in the last 30 days, new listings this week that are already being paid, and how concentrated the market is. Use it to price your own x402 endpoint, or to pick which paid tool to call.

category.description: Optional category, e.g. "scraping", "web_search", "llm", "market_data", "onchain". Omit for the whole marketplace plus a per-category table.

limit.description: How many top sellers and new listings to return (default 10).

query.description: Optional search phrase matched against listing names, descriptions and URLs, e.g. "transcription" or "weather".

name: x402_market_report
title: x402 marketplace report
